beats.say: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 drops tomorrow with a completely new cast.
It's 10 episodes, streaming only on Netflix from Tuesday 20 October.
Studio Trigger made it with CD Projekt Red, and it's set in Night City.
New characters fight their own battles across Night City, and revenge drives the story.
A new crew in the same dangerous city, and it all starts tomorrow.
